name: ipv6-catch-all-exclude-does-not-block-ipv4-valid
description: An IPv6 catch-all excluded subtree (::/0) combined with an IPv4 permitted subtree (1.2.3.0/24) must not exclude an IPv4 SAN that lies inside the IPv4 permit. iPAddress constraints are per-address-family.
references: Go name_constraints_test "IPv6 exclusion does not exclude all IPv4"
